items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He was in a picture, Ronsworth Bunkin, the Superior. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, well, he might have been.

ctx.x: Uh, Richard Payne, he was a guitar player, too. Well, I, uh, I don't remember Richard Payne so well. I saw him once or twice.
He was in a picture, Ronsworth Bunkin, the Superior.
Yes, well, he might have been.
